changes.title: rules: backtick identifiers sanitize only their own operand; quoting array_map
changes.cause: a7d7b5ef added a $QL . $QX . $QR backtick-identifier sanitizer; OpenGrep matches concatenation chains associatively, so $QX/$QR spanned later operands and sanitized the unquoted column list in ALTER TABLE `t` ADD INDEX `k` (cols).
changes.controls: 2 positives (not reported by 8d8a46c5), 4 ok controls (3 reported by 8d8a46c5); matrix 322 -> 325; pass on 1.15.0 and 2.1.0

changes.title: rules: SQL-text builders are not PHP SQL sanitizers
changes.cause: 5559c883 (in b2a2800f) made any build* method a sanitizer, so $this->buildQueryString($configuration) became clean; the only guard in the code is a keyword deny-list, which no rule treats as a sanitizer.
changes.controls: 1 positive (not reported by 7a0f9b83), 1 ok control (value-quoting buildArray); matrix 325 -> 326

changes.title: rules: local aliases of SQL identifier quoting helpers
changes.cause: the fixed-side alerts were all q(...) with const q = queryInterface.quoteIdentifier.bind(queryInterface); the $n placeholders were already sanitized by a7d7b5ef. The old-side value list IN ('${nodeIds.join("','")}') stays reported.
changes.controls: 2 ok controls (reported by 52278305), 3 positives that stay reported; matrix 326 -> 329

changes.title: rules: fail-closed containment checks clear JavaScript request path joins

changes.controls: new typescript-path-guard.ts: 7 ok controls (reported by 9dd30a1d), 6 positives (prefix-only, existence-only, non-exiting check, read before check); matrix 329 -> 335
